info.name: Openpath API Documentation auth orgs/triggerPermissionsChange API
Trigger immediate entry permission recalculation & broadcast

items.docs:
This API forces the immediate recalculation and broadcast of all entry permissions for the specified org. Do not repeatedly call this for regular permissions recalculations.

This API request is often called once after a series of x-op-triggers:bypass header related permission change API calls.

__JWT is required for this endpoint with at least one of the following scopes__: o{params.orgId}-user:w,o:w,s-o:w

__Endpoint name__: triggerPermissionsChange
